cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys,json
sys.path.insert(0,'dev'); sys.path.insert(0,'project')
import ref
from wire import emissions
ex=json.load(open('examples.json'))
case=ex[1]['input']['cases'][0]
for name,arg,frame in emissions(case):
    print(name,arg,len(frame))
    ok,parsed=ref.validate_ingress(arg,frame,case['words'])
    print('   wire_ok',ok)
    if ok: print('   ',parsed['opcode'],hex(parsed['qpn']),parsed['psn'],len(parsed['payload']))
    else:
        print('   hex',frame.hex())
EOF
